# Agents

Default agents:

## Agent Smith

A general agent with these tools:

- readfile
- edit-search-replace
- shell
- python
- run-agent
- load-skill
- notify-user
    
Dependencies: plugins: `@agent-smith/feat-fs`, `@agent-smith/feat-shell`

## Agent Smith light

Lightweight supervised agent. Tools:

- readfile
- writetofile?
- edit-search-replace?
- load-skill

The write tools require an authorization from the user

## Agent Smith search

A search agent. Tools:

- shell
- python
- ddsearch
- read-webpage

## Agent Smith help

An internal help bot to give information about the Agent Smith usage.

To use this agent you need to give it access to the source code and information. Here is how to do it: clone the repositories under a same root:

```bash
mkdir agent-smith-env
cd agent-smith-env
git clone https://github.com/lynxai-team/agent-smith.git
# git clone https://github.com/lynxai-team/agent-smith-ui.git
git clone https://github.com/lynxai-team/agent-smith-plugins.git
```

Then create a workspace in the frontend that points to the `agent-smith-env` directory, and use it to run the help bot
